biotools.summary: SeqPHASE is a tool for interconverting PHASE input/output files and FASTA sequence alignments, rewritten in Haxe and hosted on GitHub Pages. It addresses security concerns of the original Perl+CGI version and aims to provide a more modern and maintainable solution for sequence phasing.
